messages.content: Hey, it's your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you doing this week — any changes with your blood pressure or medications you want me to note?

Doing alright mostly. But I'm almost out of my metoprolol and the pharmacy says they need a brand new script from my doctor before they can refill it. It's 40 miles one way and the roads aren't great.
Got it, I've logged that you're running low on metoprolol and need a new prescription before it can be filled. Do you have a blood pressure reading from today or recently I can record for you?
Yeah I took it this morning. 151 over 93. I've got maybe four or five pills left, so a week at most.

I've logged that reading and noted the remaining supply. Running out of a blood pressure medication is something the care team needs to know about, so I've flagged this for a nurse. The median response time right now is 31 hours — they'll be able to work with you and your doctor on getting a new script sorted. I can't help with the pharmacy logistics or transportation side of it, but the nurse should be able to talk through options. Your next check-in is already scheduled for next week, and I've noted the urgency there too.
Alright, thanks. I'll keep an eye out for their call.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
